brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu appeared headed for defeat in Israel's upcoming election, but the race has tightened considerably as voting approaches, according to Al-Monitor. His rivals have yet to establish a clear route to forming a government, leaving the outcome increasingly uncertain.

The shifting dynamics complicate efforts by opposition forces to unseat the long-serving prime minister, who has maintained political resilience despite facing multiple challenges entering the contest.
dek: By Maayan Lubell JERUSALEM, Oct 26 (Reuters) - Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has long looked on course to lose power in Israel's election, but the race has narrowed as the vote approaches and his rivals have no clear path to power.
title: Netanyahu's grip on power tightens as Israel's election narrows
